sources.title: Fixed Overpass street-centreline cross-check for four boundary roads named in the announcement
sources.title_zh: 公告命名四条边界道路的固定 Overpass 街道中线背景核对
sources.publisher: OpenStreetMap contributors; reproducibility record maintained by open-city-ai/haidian contributors
sources.license_or_reuse_terms: Data © OpenStreetMap contributors, Open Database License 1.0 (ODbL): https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright. This package does not redistribute the raw response; it cites the local reproducibility record and reports only derived statistics.
sources.permitted_use: Background-only reproducibility record for comparing a median street-centreline proxy for Dazhongsi East Road, Heqing Road, Xueyuan Road, and Xitucheng Road with the registered provisional polygon edge at the same latitude.
sources.limitations: OSM is mutable crowdsourced data with uneven coverage and accuracy. A street centreline is not a road redline, parcel edge, statutory boundary, or official interpretation of the announcement. The four sampled latitude ranges differ, and Dazhongsi East Road has only one retained 965 m way. The results cannot correct, move, score, or validate any provisional or official geometry.
sources.limitations_zh: OSM 是持续变化、覆盖与精度不均的众包数据；街道中线不是道路红线、宗地边、法定边界，也不是对公告四至的官方解释。四条街的测段纬度不同，大钟寺东路仅保留 1 条、965 m 的 way，代表性较弱。结果不得用于纠正、移动、评分或验证任何 provisional/official 几何。
sources.transformation: Exact-name highway ways were queried within PROV-RESEARCH-001's bounding box; east-west branches were excluded, each street's retained-node median longitude was used as a centreline proxy, and EPSG:4548 distances were calculated to the provisional polygon edge at the segment's midpoint latitude. Only the 533–898 m derived offsets and 667 m mean are reported.

sources.title: Vulnerability Exploitability eXchange (VEX) Use Cases and Minimum Requirements
sources.title_zh: 漏洞可利用性交换（VEX）使用场景与最低要求
sources.publisher: U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency
sources.published_at: Use Cases: 2022-04; Minimum Requirements: CISA 2023-04 file path
sources.license_or_reuse_terms: Unknown / review required for redistribution: the referenced CISA documents are linked and paraphrased only. No figure or substantial text is copied; any broader reuse, including third-party material, requires checking the publisher's current terms.
sources.permitted_use: Short summary and citation of machine-readable product-vulnerability status communication.
sources.limitations: A VEX statement is context-specific and does not itself prove that a product is safe; this proposal creates no production VEX and makes no exploitability determination about a real product.
sources.limitations_zh: VEX 声明依赖具体情境，本身不能证明产品安全；本方案不生成生产级 VEX，也不对真实产品作可利用性判断。
sources.transformation: Status communication becomes a simple affected/not-yet-assessed/not-affected-with-justification public service card in a synthetic recall exercise.

sources.title: Noto Sans CJK / Noto Sans SC font license
sources.title_zh: Noto Sans CJK / Noto Sans SC 字体许可
sources.published_at: SIL Open Font License Version 1.1; exact local font build tag not recorded
sources.license_or_reuse_terms: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (OFL-1.1). The upstream license permits use, modification, bundling, embedding, and redistribution subject to its conditions, including no standalone sale, preserving the font license when font software is distributed, and reserved-font-name restrictions for modified versions. The license does not require documents created with the fonts to use OFL-1.1.
sources.permitted_use: Embed subsets in generated PDF documents and rasterize glyphs into self-made figures; record the exact local font-file hashes used for the build.
sources.limitations: No endorsement by the font authors is implied. The exact upstream release tag of the local TTF snapshots was not recorded, so SHA-256 hashes, filenames, and the upstream license URL are the reproducibility boundary. Standalone font files are not included in the submission.
sources.limitations_zh: 不得暗示字体作者认可本投稿。本地 TTF 快照未记录确切上游发布标签，因此复现边界以 SHA-256、文件名和上游许可链接为准；投稿包不包含独立字体文件。
sources.transformation: NotoSansSC-Regular.ttf and NotoSansSC-Bold.ttf are used locally to render figure labels and to subset-embed text in the four final PDF drawings; the original font files are not copied into the package.
